meta.note: 四级听力仿真题，非真题原文。男声（M）为主，结构与六级听力完全一致。

script.en: Hi, are you volunteering for the campus clean-up this Saturday?
script.cn: 嗨，你这周六报名参加校园清洁志愿活动了吗？

script.en: I signed up yesterday, but the coordinator said we still need someone to drive the truck.
script.cn: 我昨天报名了，不过协调员说我们还需要有人开车。

script.en: Do you have a driver's license then?
script.cn: 那你有驾照吗？

script.en: I've had one for three years. I can drive both the truck and the van.
script.cn: 我有三年了。卡车和面包车我都能开。

script.en: Great. I'll put you down for the truck. We meet at the main gate at eight.
script.cn: 太好了。我把你安排去开卡车。我们八点在校门口集合。

script.en: Noted. Should I bring my own gloves, or do they provide them?
script.cn: 记下了。我要自带手套吗，还是他们提供？

script.en: They provide everything. Just bring a water bottle and wear something you don't mind getting dirty.
script.cn: 他们提供所有东西。带个水瓶就行，穿件不怕脏的衣服。

qs.q: What does the man need to do for the clean-up?
qs.explain: 协调员说还需要有人开车，男子随后说自己有三年驾照，能开卡车和面包车。
qs.evidence: I signed up yesterday, but the coordinator said we still need someone to drive the truck.

qs.q: Where will the volunteers meet?
qs.explain: 女子说八点在校门口（main gate）集合。
qs.evidence: We meet at the main gate at eight.

qs.q: What should the man bring himself?
qs.explain: 女子说他们提供一切，只需自带水瓶。
qs.evidence: They provide everything. Just bring a water bottle.

script.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken? I've been looking for an empty one near the window.
script.cn: 打扰一下，这个座位有人吗？我一直在找靠窗的空位。

script.en: It's free now. My friend just left for lunch. But it gets direct sunlight in the afternoon.
script.cn: 现在没人。我朋友刚去吃午饭了。不过下午会有直射的阳光。

script.en: That's fine. I prefer a bit of sun while I read anyway.
script.cn: 没关系，我读书时反而喜欢有点阳光。

script.en: By the way, do you know when the library closes on weekends? I need to return a book.
script.cn: 顺便问一下，你知道图书馆周末几点关门吗？我要还一本书。

script.en: I think it opens at nine and closes at six on Saturdays. Sundays it stays closed.
script.cn: 我记得周六九点开、下午六点关。周日不开。

script.en: Good to know. I'll go there on Saturday then.
script.cn: 知道了。那我周六去。

qs.q: Why was the seat available?
opts: The man was going to lunch
It was reserved for the woman
The woman had booked it earlier
qs.explain: 男子说朋友刚去吃午饭了，所以座位空出来。
qs.evidence: My friend just left for lunch.

qs.q: What does the woman say about the sunlight?
qs.explain: 女子说自己读书时反而喜欢有点阳光。
qs.evidence: I prefer a bit of sun while I read anyway.

qs.q: When is the library open on Sundays?
qs.explain: 女子说周日图书馆不开门。
qs.evidence: Sundays it stays closed.

script.en: I'd like to borrow these three books, but I heard there's a limit.
script.cn: 我想借这三本书，但我听说有数量限制。

script.en: Students can take up to four at a time. Since you have three, you're fine.
script.cn: 学生一次最多可以借四本。你有三本，没问题。

script.en: And how long can I keep them?
script.cn: 我可以借多久？

script.en: Two weeks for standard books. Reference books can only be used inside the library.
script.cn: 普通书两周。参考书只能在馆内使用。

script.en: What if I need to renew them? One of them is really important for my thesis.
script.cn: 如果我想续借呢？其中一本对我的论文很重要。

script.en: You can renew once online, as long as nobody else has reserved the title. But the reference one cannot be renewed at all.
script.cn: 只要没有别人预约，你可以在线续借一次。但参考书完全不能续借。

qs.q: How many books can a student borrow at once?
qs.explain: 管理员说学生一次最多借四本。
qs.evidence: Students can take up to four at a time.

qs.q: What is the rule for reference books?
opts: They can be kept for a week
They can only be used on site
qs.explain: 参考书只能在图书馆内使用，不能外借也不能续借。
qs.evidence: Reference books can only be used inside the library.

qs.q: What is the condition for renewing online?
opts: The book must not be reserved by others
The student must pay a fee
The book must be a novel
qs.explain: 只要没有其他人预约该书种，就可以在线续借一次。
qs.evidence: You can renew once online, as long as nobody else has reserved the title.

script.en: The gym says the swimming course is full. Do you know when a new session starts?
script.cn: 体育馆说游泳课满了。你知道下一期什么时候开始吗？

script.en: I checked this morning. The next session opens on Monday and lasts eight weeks.
script.cn: 我今早查了。下一期周一开课，一共八周。

script.en: Eight weeks is quite long. Is there a shorter option?
script.cn: 八周挺长的。有短一点的选择吗？

script.en: There's an intensive four-week course, but it meets three times a week instead of once.
script.cn: 有个四周的 intensive 课程，但每周要上三次而不是一次。

script.en: Three times a week is fine with me. What time does it run?
script.cn: 一周三次我可以。它什么时候上课？

script.en: Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus Saturday morning. The fee is the same either way.
script.cn: 周二和周四，加上周六上午。两种课程费用一样。

qs.q: When does the next session of the regular course start?
qs.explain: 男子说下一期周一开课。
qs.evidence: The next session opens on Monday and lasts eight weeks.

qs.q: What is the difference between the two courses?
opts: The number of meetings per week
qs.explain: intensive 课程每周上三次，而常规课每周一次；费用相同。
qs.evidence: it meets three times a week instead of once

qs.q: Which days does the intensive course meet?
qs.explain: 周二、周四，加上周六上午。
qs.evidence: Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus Saturday morning.

script.en: Attention please, all students living on the east side of campus.
script.cn: 请注意，住在校园东侧的所有同学。

script.en: Starting next Monday, a bike-sharing scheme will begin operating on a trial basis.
script.cn: 从下周一开始，一个共享单车项目将开始试运营。

script.en: There are thirty docking stations, and you can borrow a bike with your student card at any of them.
script.cn: 共有三十个停车桩，你可以在任意一个用学生卡借车。

script.en: The first thirty minutes of each ride are free. After that, you will be charged at a low hourly rate.
script.cn: 每次骑行前三十分钟免费。超过之后按较低的时薪收费。

script.en: The scheme is intended to reduce car traffic and improve air quality around the teaching buildings.
script.cn: 该项目旨在减少车流量、改善教学区周边的空气质量。

script.en: If the trial proves successful, the university plans to expand the number of stations next term.
script.cn: 如果试点成功，学校计划下学期扩大停车桩数量。

qs.q: Who is the scheme mainly intended for?
qs.explain: 广播开头说「请注意，住在校园东侧的所有同学」，说明面向东侧学生。
qs.evidence: Attention please, all students living on the east side of campus.

qs.q: How can students borrow a bike?
qs.explain: 用学生卡在任意停车桩借车。
qs.evidence: you can borrow a bike with your student card at any of them

qs.q: What is free of charge?
opts: The first thirty minutes of each ride
qs.explain: 每次骑行前 30 分钟免费。
qs.evidence: The first thirty minutes of each ride are free.

qs.q: What will happen if the trial succeeds?
qs.explain: 如果试点成功，下学期会扩大停车桩数量。
qs.evidence: the university plans to expand the number of stations next term

script.en: Good morning. This is the lost and found office in the student centre.
script.cn: 早上好，这里是学生中心的失物招领处。

script.en: I lost a black umbrella last Tuesday. Has anyone turned it in?
script.cn: 我上周二丢了一把黑伞。有人交过来吗？

script.en: Actually yes. We have a black umbrella, though we cannot tell whose it is yet.
script.cn: 实际上有。我们有一把黑伞，不过还无法确认是谁的。

script.en: Could I describe it so you can check? It has a wooden handle and a small scratch.
script.cn: 我能描述一下让你核对吗？木把手，上面有一道小划痕。

script.en: That sounds right. Could you also tell me what is inside the pocket?
script.cn: 听起来没错。你能告诉我口袋里有什么吗？

script.en: A student card and a receipt from the campus bookstore.
script.cn: 一张学生卡和一张校园书店的收据。

script.en: Perfect. The umbrella will be returned to you after you fill in this form.
script.cn: 很好。填完这张表之后我们就把伞还给你。

qs.q: What did the man lose?
qs.explain: 男子说上周二丢了一把黑伞。
qs.evidence: I lost a black umbrella last Tuesday.

qs.q: How can the man prove the umbrella is his?
opts: By describing its features and contents
qs.explain: 通过描述特征（木把手、划痕）和口袋里的物品来确认。
qs.evidence: Could I describe it so you can check? It has a wooden handle and a small scratch.

qs.q: What is in the umbrella pocket?
opts: A student card and a receipt
qs.explain: 学生卡和校园书店收据。
qs.evidence: A student card and a receipt from the campus bookstore.

qs.q: What must the man do before getting the umbrella back?
qs.explain: 填完表格后才能领回。
qs.evidence: The umbrella will be returned to you after you fill in this form.
